## Selected Systems & Case Studies
- Theft Alert (Anshika Singh) — Real-time phishing detection via Chromium MV3 extension + Flutter companion + FastAPI heuristics + Gemini assist: https://www.teamparadox.in/work/theft-alert
- EduPortal (Aditya Chaudhari) — Academic campus OS with student/faculty/admin roles, real-time Socket.IO chat/polls/pins, offline PWA/TWA, and Flutter companion: https://www.teamparadox.in/work/eduportal
- ARIA (Om Abhishek Tripathi) — Source-grounded RAG assistant with ingestion for PDF, YouTube and GitHub, embeddings, Chroma vector store, and Groq/LangChain orchestration: https://www.teamparadox.in/work/aria
- Perkify (Abhiuday Pratap Singh) — Perks and recommendations platform with Next.js frontend, Express/JWT/Prisma backend, and isolated FastAPI assistant: https://www.teamparadox.in/work/perkify
- Career Boost (Ananya Singh) — Deterministic career companion with client-side document parsing, skill gap analysis, and auditable roadmap generators: https://www.teamparadox.in/work/career-boost
- The Local Way (Ananya Singh) — Editorial village discovery platform with stays, experiences, artisan profiles, and calm monochrome aesthetics: https://www.teamparadox.in/work/local-way
